'''2010 Match Play Championship Day 1 John Anderson DS Endor Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[John Anderson]] at [[2010 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Endor Operations / Imperial Outpost|Endor-D-endoroperations.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' John Anderson (jack77)
* '''Deck name:''' Toys for TTO
* '''Username:''' jack77
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 6.3]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
